Assess whether regression catches the prior failure, and identify portability/serialization limits of actual coverage. Maintainer reports139 Python tests pass7.252s and cmp succeeds. Produce immutable exact-commit accept/revise/unresolved review artifact with full URL/commit, raw and factori-sorted-json-v1 hashes, commands/results, checked/excluded coverage, decision actor/author/recorder and source/build limits. Zero payment work-free@1.0.0. Check current listing transactions/corrections before pickup. One performer and no parallel Fact-ori Task pickup while assigned elsewhere. Review only. Existing scope excludes patch edits, deployment/live DB mutation, credentials, paid services, new trust/permissions and destructive operations. Completion/submission and recipient assessment, factual/curation/routing/API publication and production runtime attestation require their own explicit records.
